purpose: Shared small experiment for A image generation and B program UI reconstruction. This is an explicit subset of measured modules, not a new production UI requirement.

selection.heightDerivation: max(first three card local y + card height) + captured module padding-bottom
selection.note: Derived single-row example; original capture contains nine products and three rows.

scopeNotes: Relative order follows round-1 observed modules after removing unselected repeats.
Four-icon navigation sample has no labels; do not infer all navigation variants lack labels.
Three-column poster slots are square in this captured sample.
Carousel indicator dots forbidden by latest user instruction.
Page wrappers and floating platform controls are outside this module-only comparison; this does not authorize deleting them from the existing demo.
No benefits row was measured in this sample; do not invent it.
Existing module images or clearly labelled fixtures may be used. Product fidelity and text facts must not be claimed when using fixtures.
Outside first-row showcase height and vertical concatenation, use registry component geometry/styles as measured.

mustHave: Exactly five selected modules in stated order
Three showcase product cards with square photos and separate information areas
reportSeparately: Image source and per-slot native pixels
Model calls, output images and elapsed time
Unknown costs must be labelled unknown
